question: Which of the following hill stations is NOT in Uttarakhand?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Daringbadi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Daringbadi Hill is the Kandhamal district of Odisha **state in eastern India.
 
• It is situated at a height of 3000 ft.
 
• The temperature level of Daringbadi has often been recorded below 0 °C
 
• **Daringbadi is called the Kashmir of Odisha**.
 
• It is the only place in Orissa where snowfall occurs during the winter.
 
• It has pine jungles, coffee gardens and beautiful valleys.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nainital:****​**

 
 
• Nainital is a hill station in the Indian state of Uttarakhand.
 
• **It is the judicial capital of Uttarakhand**, the High Court of the state being located there, and is the headquarters of the Kumaon division as well as an eponymous district.
 
• It lies in the Siwalik (Shiwalik) Range at an elevation of 6,346 feet (1,934 meters) above sea level.
 
• Nainital is a beautiful hill station that derived its name from Naini Lake.
 
• The Naini peak or the China peak is the highest in Nainital with a height of 8578 feet.
 
 
 
• **Mussoorie****:****​**
 
 
• Mussoorie is a hill station which is in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. 
 
• The hill station is located in the foothills of the** Garhwal Himalayan range**.
 
• Mussoorie is popularly known as The Queen of the Hills.
 
• In Mussoorie, “**Lal Tibba**” is the most famous place.
 
• The place is the highest peak of the topmost point.
